label: 4th original token after a u/3/v/p + u/o + o/t/2 prefix
explanation: Sparse early-original-phase feature (0.01% of steps). 99.7% of mass is in the original phase at t=2..4, and 80% at t=3. It essentially never fires in the delimiter or copy phase. It fires when the prefix is drawn from a small token cluster: the first token is u/3/v/p (u has 12x lift), the middle tokens are u/o, and the immediately previous token is o/t/2 (about 12x lift each). The current input modulates it, with p/r/f strongest (5-8x lift; top activations are e.g. 3 o 2 [p], u o t [r]), but other current tokens also fire at lower magnitude. The t==3 prefix predicate has precision of about 0.5 and recall of about 0.34 on dev. It misses t=2 firings (u o [p/f]) and looser prefixes (3 2 o, v w 2). Its false positives are cases with the right prefix where the current token is w/b/h/m etc. Activation looks like a graded combination of prefix-cluster membership plus current token, not a clean boolean rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev2_tok=u (+3.41), prev_tok=t (+3.24), prev_tok=2 (+3.20), prev3_tok=3 (+3.01), orig0=u (+3.01), prev_tok=o (+2.93). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.80), orig3=n (-1.81), orig_idx=-1 (-1.58), in_first=0 (-0.83).
